summary: Tested the fix that adds 5 entities to the Backup Center 'Respaldo Total (1 clic)' (now 19). Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. The entities list has 19 items, including economic-groups(46), brands(779), integrator-companies(379), integrator-certificates(36) and referentes(5); these counts match MongoDB. export-zip with all 19 modules returns 19 json files + _manifest.json, and each new file's documents equal its count. import-preview-zip recognizes 19 entities with skipped_files=[]. A TEST_ brand was created AFTER the export, then import-zip mode=replace was run with the SAME freshly exported ZIP: 0 errors, 19 results, brands deleted>=1, the TEST_ brand returns 404 afterwards and every entity count is identical to before. Before the destructive test, a DB check confirmed no docs in any of the 20 underlying collections lack their key field and there are no duplicate keys, so replace could not wipe keyless docs. UI (/settings/backup-center): 19 rows show, including the 5 new ones with correct labels and counts. Clicking export-all-btn downloads respaldo_total_*.zip with 20 files (19 + _manifest.json), and the toast reads 'Respaldo TOTAL generado: 19 entidad(es) en un ZIP'. History shows the masivo replica restore.
critical_code_review_comments: _apply_upsert_docs replace mode: delete_many({key: {$nin: keep}}) also deletes any doc missing the key field. These docs are exported but skipped on import (missing_key), so a roundtrip would silently lose them. Today no collection has such docs. Consider filtering with {key: {$exists: true, $nin: keep}} or reporting them.
Replace/upsert stamps updated_at/updated_by on every existing doc, so the restore is not byte-exact (it overwrites the backup's updated_at). Minor.
import-zip is not transactional and applies modules in alphabetical order. A failure mid-way leaves a partial restore; only errors[] reports it.
Any records created by other users between the export and a replace restore are deleted. This is expected for a replica, but the UI warning should state it clearly.
data_migration.py is over 3200 lines; it should be split (backup-center, quotes-bundle, full-backup).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_brand_* created via POST /api/marcas after the export; the replace restore removed it (verified 404). No residual data.
